mapper.select: SELECT dc.id, dc.name_cn, dc.name_en, dc.short_name_cn, dc.short_name_en, dc.region_code, dga.region_name AS areaName, dc.subregion_code, dga.subregion_name, dc.disabled FROM dict_country dc LEFT JOIN dict_global_area dga -- ON dc.region_code=dga.id ON dc.subregion_code=dga.id WHERE dc.is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY dc.index DESC

SELECT dc.id, dc.name_cn, dc.name_en, dc.short_name_cn, dc.short_name_en, dc.region_code, dga.region_name AS areaName, dc.subregion_code, dga.subregion_name, dc.disabled FROM dict_country dc LEFT JOIN dict_global_area dga ON dc.region_code=dga.id WHERE dc.is_deleted = FALSE
and (dc.id ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') or dc.name_cn ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') or dc.name_en ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%'))
ORDER BY dc.index DESC
